build_extension_nl2br: build a Python-Markdown extension that treats newlines as hard breaks like GitHub-flavored Markdown
create_Nl2BrExtension: create an Nl2BrExtension instance to register newline-to-br substitution in a Markdown instance
test_extendMarkdown: test the extendMarkdown method to verify it registers a SubstituteTagInlineProcessor for newline patterns
refactor_Nl2BrExtension: refactor the Nl2BrExtension class to customize the regex pattern or priority for newline matching
summarize_makeExtension: summarize the makeExtension factory function that returns a configured Nl2BrExtension instance with kwargs
